Package com.example.linko

Class Event

java.lang.Object
com.example.linko.Event
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Event extends Object implements Serializable
This is for Event objects. Stores all the necessary info for events as well as lists for managing entrants. Has an empty constructor for Firebase.

There are two separate constructors in this class. One for when the Firebase ownerId is known before creation and then the main constructor that's used more often where the ownerId isn't known ahead of time.

    • Event

      public Event(String ownerId, String name, Integer eventCapacity, Integer entrantLimit, boolean geolocationRequired, Date eventTime, Date registrationStart, Date registrationEnd, String description, String guidelines, String eventPosterURL, String eventId)
      Event info object. On constructor call, makes new entrants, invitedEntrants, signedUpEntrants, and cancelledEntrants arrayLists.

      ownerId and eventId are added added later when info is pulled from Firebase database

      Parameters:
      ownerId - Owner ID
      name - Event name
      eventCapacity - Entrant capacity for event
      entrantLimit - :
      geolocationRequired - Boolean used to check if geolocation is necessary for event
      eventTime - What time the event takes place
      registrationStart - When registration for the event starts
      registrationEnd - When event registration closes
      description - Event description
      eventPosterURL - Firebase URL for the events poster
      eventId - Event ID
